datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data were collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly basis throughout 2014 (January, April, July, October) and spatially encoded as geographic features with classification scales and scenario assessments. The data represent post-assessment food insecurity impact classifications at sub-national administrative units in Rwanda.
